messages.subject: re post of encoding issue, error message on loading to Shiny server (ShinyApps.io)
parts:
Hi, I tried to post this question on Sunday, deletrf message by mistake while trying to edit.   I have a Shiny app running locally (and since deployed and running on an AWS server.)

When I use deployApp() to use the ShinyApps.io, I get this error message:

> deployApp()
Preparing to deploy application...
Update application currently deployed at
http://iecodesign.shinyapps.io/shiny-app2? [Y/n] y
DONE
Uploading application bundle...
Error in parse(input, n = -1L, encoding = checkEncoding(file)) : 
  11:7: unexpected symbol
10:     sidebarPanel
11:       selectInput
          ^



I have set the encoding of the ui and server scripts to UTF8  using Save with Encoding in RStudio.  

The selectInput function call is:

selectInput("choose_var",label="Choose variable",choices=list_vars1),


list_vars1 is a character vector, in the global environment.

I am running Windows 7 Pro SP1, RStudio version 0.98.932
